asset_set: Questionnaire Q16 option 2 — Documenting wildlife behavior

art_style.reference: Match src/assets/1.1.png and 1.2.png — unDraw-style full-body edu characters
art_style.fill: solid flat color blocks with minimal cel shade
art_style.mood: quiet curious field-science energy — approachable naturalist hobby, not sterile lab
forbidden: hunting weapon or trapped animal imagery

color.background: transparent — faint grey decorative circles allowed at 15% opacity

character.face: minimal — two dot eyes, small smile, no detailed nose
character.diversity_note: unique cast per slot — female presentation, deep brown skin, afro puff distinguishes from other slots

pose.stance: full body, crouched profile at the edge of tall grass
pose.action: raising binoculars to her eyes with one hand while balancing an open field notebook on her knee, pencil in the other hand
pose.facing: left profile, gaze tracking toward distant birds

top.garment: sleeveless field vest over long-sleeve tee
top.detail: charcoal collar trim, teal zipper pull

subject.scene_narrative: A young woman crouches at a grassy field edge, binoculars raised in one hand and a pencil sketching a bird silhouette into her field notebook with the other — quiet naturalist patience captured full-body, in the same approachable maker language as the approved Q1 references.
subject.hero_prop: rubber-armored binoculars raised to eye level, teal-tinted lens rims
supporting_props: open field notebook resting on knee with a simple bird sketch
two soft-focus bird silhouettes in the distance
subject.environment: thin grassy field-edge line, faint grey decorative circles behind figure — no sky detail, no wall

composition.layout: figure left-of-center crouched low, binoculars and gaze directing eye toward upper-right distant birds, balanced like 1.1.png
composition.thumbnail_test: silhouette of crouched person + binoculars readable at 160px

generation.negative_prompt: face photograph, realistic skin pores, text, watermark, letter I, border frame, sticker card, top-down POV hands only, white background fill, photorealistic, 3d render, cropped head, extra limbs, hunting weapon, trapped or injured animal, guns, blood

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector full-body illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background.
